title: Roguelite MMO New Player Feedback Request
author: HeadHunterX223
selftext:
https://roguelite-mmo.com

So honestly the game has done better than I had expected first and foremost (it is just a for fun pet project after all). With that though I've noticed two types of players. One's who login and almost immediately stop playing and those who try it out and generally come back here and there through the day (these are the players im happy to have).

I am looking for new users though to check out the game and give honest feedback of why its instantly a "no thank you" before even attempting the tutorial quests. Looking for honest feedback please!

(Note the one area I could see as instantly boring is explore. Im actually working on some optional Roguelite events there to spice it up)

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body:
there's no design continuity. The aesthetic is basically just noise everywhere I look. It's too hard to learn because it's too hard to focus on any one thing.

good UI is often about limiting the screen to only a few options at a time. There's no streamlining. I think most people leave right away because it's painful to interact with this thing.

replies.author: HeadHunterX223
replies.body: Appreciate the feedback! I am definitely trying to figure out the best layout while not requiring extra clicks because i find that to be detrimental as well. Did you try it out on desktop or mobile? Thanks again for taking the time to try and reply!

replies.author: darknessinducedlove
replies.body:
Theres nothing unique or engaging about this.

Ita the epitome of slop

replies.author: HeadHunterX223
replies.body: Its still in beta, but roguelite exploring, roguelite dungeons, fishing, horse taming/riding/training/betting, guild wars, pvp arena, crafting and more! The more helpful feedback would have been "too much going on, I don't understand it" but I have actually heard those people loud and clear and will be introducing a new intro!

replies.author: darknessinducedlove
replies.body: Tell me, is this all text based?

replies.author: HeadHunterX223
replies.body:
No there are turned based pve and pvp fights (trinity/rock, paper and scissors type battles with shields you need to break), active mini games for gathering, active fishing, casino and live horse racing as the "not just looking at text" type activities 

(Strategic weekly 3 lane guild wars as well once the player base can support it)

comments.author: Swimming_Evidence_95
comments.body:
As someone else said theres to much going on. Maybe if you unlocked a piece of the ui at the time (still bot to fast) one couls maybe figure it out IF one enjoy the contebt. I coulsnt get into it, seems like you put some time into it so its a shame (if other can get into it grats). Also one kmprtant note i believe, i almost closed the game before it started. I did not see why i couldnt press start game or whatever, by chance i scrolled up an saw i had to enter a name. It looked like i didnt have to fill it in i was calles rogueone it looked like. 

Anyway glhf

replies.author: HeadHunterX223
replies.body: Appreciate the feedback and agreed! Reworking a  "guided unlock" system! Noted on the default name text! Than you!

comments.author: EnumeratedArray
comments.body: The UI is an assault on the eyes.

replies.author: HeadHunterX223
replies.body: Appreciate the feedback! Did you test in desktop or mobile?

comments.author: Useful_Use_6170
comments.body:
Tested in mobile, yeah it’s not for mobile so many buttons  and some clipper over the other. But you have a ui/UX overload want a piece of advice do this:  
1- take screen shots of all the scenes you are gonna change, but start with 1 first until you feel it’s perfect.  
2- give it to ChatGPT let it know your issue, tell ChatGPT to take the roll of a game designer with expertise in game design UI/UX and tell it what you’re “Testers” are complaint to you about.  
3- take that list save it and then tell ChatGPT “ Render me a Mockup of how you would redesign everything.  
4- then take that knowledge and improve ur UI

replies.author: HeadHunterX223
replies.body: Appreciate the feedback and good idea, yea the difficulty im having is allowing mobile to have the same functionality as desktop without extra screens/clicks. But yea ive been using codex a lot, I should go back and try gpt for the ui again, it does do a lot better with visuals/ui I feel like. I just got trapped by the ease of codex
